$schema_note: Zero-Card ledger. One entry per external service. Re-verify every 30 days against the official pricing page before adopting. Limits are snapshots, not guarantees.

policy.rule_if_card_requested: stop, do not enter card, pick fallback, log the incident here

services.role: static hosting of the booking site
services.limits: public repos: 1 GB site, 100 GB/month soft bandwidth, 10 builds/hour
services.terms_note: static sites only, no server-side code; commercial use allowed
services.adapter: static files at repo root; no provider-specific code

services.terms_note: verify current free plan wording before adopting
services.adapter: same static bundle, no code change

services.limits: free credit-based plan; verify credit allotment
services.terms_note: credit model changes often — read the pricing page before adopting

services.role: clinic backend: booking rules, Sheets persistence, Calendar events
services.limits: consumer account quotas: 20k UrlFetch calls/day, 90 min/day trigger runtime, Sheets 10M cells, Calendar read/write subject to Google quota changes
services.terms_note: consumer quotas are not an SLA; clinic must accept documented limits before go-live
services.quota_config: SLOT_MINUTES, WORK_DAYS, WORK_START/END, LLM_DAILY_LIMIT, LLM_HOURLY_LIMIT (Script Properties)
services.fallback: self-hosted Node backend behind the same google.script.run-shaped API
services.adapter: app.js talks only to api()/callServer(); Code.gs is the single provider file

services.role: system of record for requests, audit trail, closures
services.limits: no automatic backups on free tier; 10M cells per file
services.terms_note: no PII beyond contact fields; no medical data ever
services.adapter: requestsSheet_/auditSheet_/closuresSheet_ are the only Sheet touch points

services.role: source of truth for doctor availability
services.limits: read/write quotas change without notice; availability reads cached 30s

services.role: optional administrative assistant (never in booking decisions)
services.limits: free tier limits were reduced in Dec 2025 — read live limits in AI Studio; this app caps itself at LLM_DAILY_LIMIT (25) and LLM_HOURLY_LIMIT (20)
services.terms_note: free-tier inputs may be used to improve models → no PII/medical text is forwarded (screened in Code.gs before the adapter)
services.adapter: Llm.gs only — swapping provider = editing LLM.PROVIDERS

services.role: fallback LLM provider for the administrative assistant
services.limits: free tier with per-minute and per-day token limits — verify live in console
services.terms_note: add a PROVIDERS entry before relying on it; do not send PII
services.quota_config: reuses LLM_* settings; provider model name stays in Script Properties
services.adapter: Llm.gs PROVIDERS.groq (not implemented yet — secondary chain slot in LLM_CHAIN is ignored until defined)

services.role: bridge long memory: evidence, backups, inbox (drive.file)
services.limits: 15 GB shared with Gmail and Photos; ~750 GB/day upload soft cap; 12k requests/min per user
services.terms_note: free consumer quota; no billing required for API use within quota
services.quota_config: quota() in scripts/google/selftest.js; alert at 80% in profile

services.role: OAuth 2.0 Desktop client for the system account's refresh token
services.limits: no cost; 100 refresh tokens per client per account (oldest invalidated)
services.terms_note: Testing status tokens die in 7 days → publish to In production
services.fallback: local adapter; no OAuth needed for CI

known_card_required_avoided.reason: business-initiated messages are billed per delivery and Meta requires a payment method; adopted here only as an off/dry-run adapter — see docs/prd/whatsapp-cloud-api.md
